name: Production outbound traffic must use Central Egress
description: Internet-bound traffic from MTF and PROD goes through the transit gateway to Central Egress, where Network Firewall inspects it before NAT.

name: Application VPCs must not reach the internet directly
description: Application VPCs have no route to their own internet gateway; all internet traffic uses Central Egress or Central Ingress.

name: Inbound traffic enters through Central Ingress and a load balancer
description: Requests reach applications from Central Ingress over the transit gateway and through the application's load balancer.

name: On-premises traffic uses the transit gateway and Direct Connect
description: Traffic to on-premises networks routes through the central transit gateway to Direct Connect; no VPN or VGW per account.
